summary: 3 juil : Dow ATH 52,904 (+0.69%). AAPL +4.84% record $262.57. TSLA -7.49% Robotaxi delay. XLV 52W high. META -4.90% reversal. NFP released. Early close 1PM ET. RISK-ON 62%, VIX 16.30. WTI $67.50. BTC $60,200.

risks.label: TSLA crash -7.49% — Robotaxi regulatory delay sparks confidence crisis
risks.detail: Tesla fell -7.49% to $338.72 after NHTSA delayed robotaxi approval timeline to 2028. Volume surged to 85M+ (2x average). Broke below 50-day EMA. Next support $320. Risk of contagion to broader EV/autonomous sector.

risks.label: META reversal -4.90% — AI compute pivot honeymoon over
risks.detail: Meta reversed -4.90% to $582.87 after Wednesday's +8.81% surge. Market questioning compute monetization timeline. Semis stabilizing but not recovering. AI narrative still fragile.

risks.label: Holiday liquidity vacuum — July 4 early close, thin volumes through Monday
risks.detail: Markets closed at 1PM ET Friday. July 4 Saturday. Extended weekend with minimal liquidity. Any geopolitical surprise or Monday gap risk amplified. Sizing discipline critical.

risks.label: Yields elevated — 10Y at 4.48%, testing 4.50% resistance
risks.detail: 10Y yields remain near 4.48% post-NFP. 30Y approaching 5.00% psychological level. Rate-sensitive sectors (REITs, utilities) under pressure. TLT near $85.50. Fed hike pricing at 80% for September.

risks.label: WTI crude breakdown — $67.50, ceasefire draining risk premium
risks.detail: Oil below $68 support. Iran-US ceasefire (Qatar Day 5) treated as durable by market. Next support $66 (March low). Energy sector underperforming. Collapse of ceasefire = $5+ spike risk.

risks.label: BTC structural weakness — $60,200, -52% from 52W high
risks.detail: Bitcoin holding above $58,076 floor but unable to rally meaningfully. Still -52% from $126,198 high. Equity-crypto divergence persists. Break below $58K targets $52-55K.

events.label: Dow Jones ATH — 52,904.24, first new high since mid-June
events.detail: Dow broke to all-time high at 52,904.24 (+0.69%). Driven by AAPL +4.84%, JNJ at 52W high, UNH +2.1%. Breadth confirms — 24/30 Dow components green. Rotation into blue-chip quality from speculative tech.

events.label: NFP released — labor market data shapes Fed trajectory
events.detail: Nonfarm payrolls released at 8:30AM ET (moved from Friday for July 4). Market reaction digested in half-session. Fed hike probability at 80% for September.

events.label: AAPL record high $262.57 — Apple Intelligence monetization thesis
events.detail: Apple surged +4.84% to $262.57, new all-time high. AI subscription premium hardware cycle thesis gaining traction. $4.1T market cap. Best single-day gain in 3 months.

events.label: Healthcare breakout — XLV at 52W high $163.42
events.detail: XLV hit new 52-week high at $163.42 (+2.6%). JNJ at 52W high. Biotech outperforming. Defensive rotation leader. Healthcare weight in SPX at multi-year high.

events.label: Early close 1PM ET — July 4 observed Friday
events.detail: Half-session Friday. Markets closed Saturday for Independence Day. Three-day weekend creates gap risk. Any surprise produces outsized moves in thin liquidity.

events.label: US-Iran Qatar talks Day 5 — ceasefire holding
events.detail: Iran ceasefire continues. Oil pricing it as durable ($67.50 WTI). Collapse = immediate $5+ spike. FIFA World Cup providing diplomatic cover for extended talks.

opportunities.label: XLV — Healthcare breakout, new 52W high confirmed
opportunities.detail: XLV broke to $163.42, new 52-week high with RSI 72. Leadership confirmed by volume. Entry on pullback to EMA20 (~$156). R:R 1:2.0. Defensive quality play in late-cycle rotation.

opportunities.label: XLF — Financials near 52W high, M&A + steepening tailwinds
opportunities.detail: XLF at $54.78, 3.2% below 52W high. M&A wave ($4T PwC forecast) + yield curve steepening + tech rotation = triple catalyst. PE 17.3x. Entry pullback to $54.50.

opportunities.label: GLD — Mean reversion bounce, RSI near 35 oversold
opportunities.detail: GLD near $370, RSI ~35. Historically bounces 3-5% within 5 days at these levels. Contrarian play. Entry $368, target $385, stop $360. R:R 1:2.75.

opportunities.label: Rotation leaders — international & gold miners as DXY cracks
opportunities.detail: DXY below 101. EFA (ex-US) near 52-week high above all rising EMAs. GDX reclaiming EMA20. Rotation thesis favors non-US and commodities over tech wreck.

opportunities.label: AAPL — New ATH, Apple Intelligence monetization cycle
opportunities.detail: AAPL at $262.57 new record. Apple Intelligence subscription model = recurring revenue upgrade. Above all moving averages. Momentum play with $270 target on continuation.

opportunities.label: Dow blue-chip quality — ATH breakout with broad participation
opportunities.detail: Dow at 52,904 ATH with 24/30 components green. Quality rotation from speculative to blue-chip. DIA outperforming QQQ. Breadth confirms sustainability of breakout.

regime_blips.label: RISK-ON holds at ~62% — rotation, not retreat
regime_blips.detail: Regime score ~5/100 (deep risk-on). ERO 0%, crisis 0%. Dow ATH + healthcare breakout confirm underlying strength. TSLA/META selloffs are sector-specific, not systemic. VIX 16.30. Full sizing maintained.

regime_blips.label: The Great Reshuffle — Dow vs Nasdaq divergence widens
regime_blips.detail: Dow +0.69% to ATH while Nasdaq flat/negative. DIA outperforming QQQ by 2+ percentage points over 5 sessions. Capital rotating from momentum tech to quality blue-chip. Rotation within risk-on.

regime_blips.label: Defensive-quality leadership — XLV, JNJ, UNH at 52W highs
regime_blips.detail: Healthcare breaking out to new highs while semis crash. Defensive sectors leading within a risk-on regime = late-cycle rotation pattern. Not bearish yet but character change.

regime_blips.label: VIX compression pre-holiday — 16.30, no fear despite rotation
regime_blips.detail: VIX at 16.30, well below 20 threshold. Market not pricing systemic risk from TSLA -7.5% or META reversal. Holiday-shortened week naturally suppresses vol. Watch for gap risk Monday.
